ai_overview.text: For fungal infection treatment in Guntur, consult qualified dermatologists who can provide accurate diagnosis and proper prescription medications , avoiding over-the-counter steroid creams that worsen fungal issues. Top-rated skin clinics in the area include Chandana Skin Clinic in Arundelpet, Dr. Uma's Skin Hair & Laser Clinic in Pattabhipuram, and Leelavathi Advanced Skin & Laser Center in Kothapet. Justdial +4 Recommended Skin Clinics in Guntur Chandana Skin Clinic : Located at 18/1 Arundelpet (behind Joyalukkas, near Siva Cinemas); known for comprehensive dermatology care. Dr. Uma's Skin Hair & Laser Clinic : Located on Main Road, Pattabhipuram (opposite Indian Oil); highly rated for skin and fungal treatments. Leelavathi Advanced Skin & Laser Center : Located on Puvvada Vari Street, Kothapet (opposite Yarras Hospital). Dr. Saranya's Skin Care : Located on the 1st Line of Chandramouli Nagar / 4th Line Laxmipuram. Justdial +4 Treatment Best Practices Avoid Steroids : Never use leftover combination creams containing steroids (like clobetasol or betamethasone), as they cause fungal infections to rebound and spread aggressively. Instagram · Yashoda Medicity Complete the Course : Continue applying prescribed antifungal creams or taking oral medication for the full duration recommended by your doctor, even if the itching stops. Instagram · Yashoda Medicity +3 Hygiene : Wash clothes and bedsheets in hot water, avoid tight synthetic clothing, and keep skin folds dry to prevent reinfection.
